description: This file defines functions for database operations related to a notes application, including connecting to a MySQL database, fetching all notes, fetching a note by ID, creating, updating, and deleting notes.

methods.name: int _env_int(name: str, default: int)
methods.description: Reads an environment variable and converts it to an integer, returning a default if not set or invalid.

methods.name: Connection get_connection()
methods.description: Creates and returns a new MySQL database connection configured with environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Dict[str,Any]],int,Optional[int]] _execute_one( query: str, params: Optional[Tuple[Any, ...]] = None )
methods.description: Executes a single SQL query and returns the result set, affected row count, and last inserted ID.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_all_notes()
methods.description: Fetches all notes ordered by most recent update or creation.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_note_by_id(note_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a single note by its ID, or returns None if not found.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_note(title: str, content: str)
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database and returns the created record.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_note(note_id: int, title: Optional[str], content: Optional[str])
methods.description: Partially updates a note's title and/or content and returns the updated record.

methods.name: bool delete_note(note_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, returning True if deletion was successful.

ctags.name: create_note
ctags.pattern: /^def create_note(title: str, content: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.pattern: /^def update_note(note_id: int, title: Optional[str], content: Optional[str]) -> Optional[Dict[str/
